title: A review record -- a judgement of a card's work by someone who did not do it (ADR-025 decision 7)
description: Kept as evidence beside the card it judges (`docs/work/evidence/<card>/`). The reviewer is named, the verdict is one of two words, and what was reviewed is a revision or a range, so the judgement points at bytes rather than at a memory. A reviewer who is the card's owner, or who ever moved it, is an author of the work reviewing it, and that reading proves nothing (separation of duties).

reviewed.description: What was judged: a revision, or a range `base..head`.
